item_short_desc: Rothco’s Map Compass is two tools in one!  Built with multiple ruler measurements, this survival compass can measure where you are on a map and guide you to your next destination when used in conjunction with the map’s scale.
description: Rothco’s Map Compass is two tools in one!  Built with multiple ruler measurements, this survival compass can measure where you are on a map and guide you to your next destination when used in conjunction with the map’s scale. This outdoor compass is made of lightweight and durable plastic material to help last your next outdoor venture. Measuring at 14cm X 6cm X 1.5cm, the acrylic compass is a small but great addition to your outdoor gear collection. The liquid filled map compass features a large and easy to read turn dial, magnifying glass, fine graduations, and a lanyard.
